system.description:
Grants the ability to fly at high speeds beyond an atmosphere.

  • Level 1: Primitive near-planetary travel (up to 10,000 kph); days to moon, years to nearby planets
  • Level 2: Slow interplanetary travel (up to 100,000 kph); hours to moon, month to nearby planets
  • Level 3: Average interplanetary travel; days between nearby planets
  • Level 4: Fast interplanetary travel; hours between nearby planets
  • Level 5: Extrasolar travel; minutes between planets, years between nearby stars
  • Level 6: Slow FTL travel; weeks between star systems
